overall: The AG found no violation: the executive session minutes concerned matters still ongoing when the complaint was filed, and the Board later reviewed and released them on a rolling basis.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely review and release executive session minutes from April through July 2016 after their secrecy purposes had expired.
allegations.key_passage: Because the executive session minutes concerned ongoing matters at the time this complaint was filed, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by withholding them from public disclosure.
